1: // Simple Meteor Shield game with enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // size canvas to its displayed size
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10: 
11:   const shield = { width: 80, height: 10, x: canvas.width / 2 - 40, y: canvas.height - 20 };
12:   // audio setup
13:   let audioCtx = null;
14:   const initAudio = () => {
15:     if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
16:   };
17:   const playTone = (freq, dur) => {
18:     initAudio();
19:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
20:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
21:     osc.type = 'square';
22:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
25:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
26:     osc.start();
27:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
28:   };
29:   const meteors = [];
30:   let health = 5;
31:   let lastSpawn = 0;
32:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
33: 
34:   // input handling
35:   const moveShield = (dx) => {
36:     shield.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - shield.width, shield.x + dx));
37:   };
38:   window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
39:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
40:     const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
41:     shield.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - shield.width, mouseX - shield.width / 2));
42:   });
43:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
44:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') moveShield(-10);
45:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') moveShield(10);
46:   });
47: 
48:   const spawnMeteor = () => {
49:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 10;
50:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - radius * 2) + radius;
51:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
52:     meteors.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
53:   };
54: 
55:   const update = (dt) => {
56:     // spawn
57:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
58:       spawnMeteor();
59:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
60:     }
61:     // move meteors
62:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
63:       const m = meteors[i];
64:       m.y += m.speed;
65:       // collision with shield
66:       if (
67:         m.y + m.radius >= shield.y &&
68:         m.x > shield.x &&
69:         m.x < shield.x + shield.width
70:       ) {
71:         // create explosion effect
72:         createExplosion(m.x, m.y);
73:         // play hit sound
74:         playTone(440, 0.1);
75:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
76:         continue;
77:       }
78:       // missed
79:       if (m.y - m.radius > canvas.height) {
80:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
81:         health--;
82:         if (health <= 0) {
83:           // game over, stop animation
84:           playTone(150, 0.5);
85:           alert('Game Over');
86:           window.location.reload();
87:         }
88:       }
89:     }
90:     // update particles
91:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
92:       const p = particles[i];
93:       p.x += p.vx;
94:       p.y += p.vy;
95:       p.life--;
96:       if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
97:     }
98:       // missed
99:       if (m.y - m.radius > canvas.height) {
100:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
101:         health--;
102:         if (health <= 0) {
103:           // game over, stop animation
104:           playTone(150, 0.5);
105:           alert('Game Over');
106:           window.location.reload();
107:         }
108:       }
109:     }
110:   };
111: 
112:   // Star field for background
113:   const stars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
114:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
115:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
116:     radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
117:     opacity: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5
118:   }));
119: 
120:   // particles for explosion
121:   const particles = [];
122:   const createExplosion = (x, y) => {
123:     for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
124:       particles.push({
125:         x,
126:         y,
127:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
128:         vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
129:         radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
130:         life: 30 + Math.random() * 20
131:       });
132:     }
133:   };
134: 
135:   const draw = () => {
136:     // background
137:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
138:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001020');
139:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
140:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
141:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
142:     // stars
143:     stars.forEach(s => {
144:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.opacity})`;
145:       ctx.beginPath();
146:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
147:       ctx.fill();
148:     });
149:     // shield with rounded corners
150:     ctx.fillStyle = '#4A90E2';
151:     ctx.beginPath();
152:     ctx.moveTo(shield.x + 10, shield.y);
153:     ctx.lineTo(shield.x + shield.width - 10, shield.y);
154:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(shield.x + shield.width, shield.y, shield.x + shield.width, shield.y + 10);
155:     ctx.lineTo(shield.x + shield.width, shield.y + shield.height - 10);
156:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(shield.x + shield.width, shield.y + shield.height, shield.x + shield.width - 10, shield.y + shield.height);
157:     ctx.lineTo(shield.x + 10, shield.y + shield.height);
158:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(shield.x, shield.y + shield.height, shield.x, shield.y + shield.height - 10);
159:     ctx.lineTo(shield.x, shield.y + 10);
160:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(shield.x, shield.y, shield.x + 10, shield.y);
161:     ctx.fill();
162:     // meteors with radial gradient
163:     meteors.forEach(m => {
164:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, m.radius * 0.3, m.x, m.y, m.radius);
165:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#CCCCCC');
166:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#666666');
167:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
168:       ctx.beginPath();
169:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
170:       ctx.fill();
171:     });
172:     // particles
173:     particles.forEach((p, i) => {
174:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
175:       ctx.beginPath();
176:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
177:       ctx.fill();
178:     });
179:     // health
180:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
181:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
182:     ctx.fillText('Health: ' + health, 10, 20);
183:   };
184: 
185:   let lastTime = performance.now();
186:   const loop = () => {
187:     const now = performance.now();
188:     const dt = now - lastTime;
189:     lastTime = now;
190:     update(dt);
191:     draw();
192:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
193:   };
194:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
195: })();
